name: schema_first
sql: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_catalog='frozen' AND table_name IN ('nodes','edges','macro_invocations') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position

rows.data_type: STRUCT(kind VARCHAR, renamed_from STRUCT(kind VARCHAR, file STRUCT(path VARCHAR, "encoding" VARCHAR, bytes VARCHAR), symbol STRUCT(stable_symbol_id VARCHAR, "commit" VARCHAR)))
STRUCT(raw_text VARCHAR, "owner" STRUCT(stable_symbol_id VARCHAR, kind VARCHAR), byte_range UBIGINT[], line_range UBIGINT[])[]
STRUCT(kind VARCHAR, definition STRUCT(file_path VARCHAR, source_oid VARCHAR, byte_range UBIGINT[], line_range UBIGINT[]))

name: exact_owner_hint_candidates
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN owner_candidates=0 THEN 'zero' WHEN owner_candidates=1 THEN 'one' ELSE 'multiple' END AS multiplicity,count(*) AS sites,sum(owner_candidates) AS pairs FROM calls GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

name: exact_owner_hint_samples_limit_12
sql:
SELECT e.logical_path,e.edge_id,e.target_label,e.receiver_text,e.scope_text,e.owner_candidates,n.label AS caller,p.start_line,p.end_line,
substring(hex(s.source_bytes),2*CAST(p.start_byte AS BIGINT)+1,2*CAST(least(p.end_byte-p.start_byte,6000) AS BIGINT)) AS caller_source_hex
FROM owner_sample e JOIN frozen.main.nodes n ON n.logical_path=e.logical_path AND n.node_id=e.source_node_id
JOIN frozen.main.spans p ON p.logical_path=n.logical_path AND p.span_id=n.source_span_id
JOIN frozen.main.sources s ON s.logical_path=e.logical_path
ORDER BY e.logical_path,e.edge_id LIMIT 12

name: owner_candidate_top_15
sql: SELECT scope_text,target_label,count(*) AS sites FROM calls WHERE owner_candidates=1 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY sites DESC,scope_text,target_label LIMIT 15

name: explicit_crate_paths_limit_12
sql:
SELECT e.logical_path,e.edge_id,e.target_label,e.receiver_text,e.scope_text,n.label AS caller,p.start_line,p.end_line,
substring(hex(s.source_bytes),2*CAST(p.start_byte AS BIGINT)+1,2*CAST(least(p.end_byte-p.start_byte,6000) AS BIGINT)) AS caller_source_hex
FROM crate_sample e JOIN frozen.main.nodes n ON n.logical_path=e.logical_path AND n.node_id=e.source_node_id
JOIN frozen.main.spans p ON p.logical_path=n.logical_path AND p.span_id=n.source_span_id
JOIN frozen.main.sources s ON s.logical_path=e.logical_path
ORDER BY e.logical_path,e.edge_id LIMIT 12

name: explicit_spelling_partition
sql:
WITH hints AS (SELECT *,split_part(coalesce(nullif(scope_text,''),CASE WHEN target_label LIKE '%::%' THEN target_label ELSE NULL END),'::',1) AS root FROM calls)
SELECT CASE WHEN root IN ('std','core','alloc') THEN 'std_core_alloc_spelling'
WHEN root='crate' THEN 'crate_spelling'
WHEN root IN (SELECT alias FROM workspace_roots) THEN 'workspace_crate_spelling'
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dependency_roots d WHERE d.package=h.package AND d.alias=h.root) THEN 'declared_dependency_alias_spelling'
WHEN root IS NOT NULL THEN 'other_scope_or_qualified_spelling' ELSE 'no_scope_or_qualified_spelling' END AS evidence,count(*) AS sites
FROM hints h GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
